ui.nav.pitch_down_tip: Move pitch view down one octave
ui.nav.pitch_up_tip: Move pitch view up one octave
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.tip.note_preview: Play a synth preview for placed notes.
ui.tip.preview_octave: Shift note preview audio by octaves. This does not move notes or affect export.
ui.tip.preview_sound: Synth sound used for note preview. This does not affect export.
ui.tip.export_octave: Shift MIDI/ADOFAI export by octaves. This does not affect preview or note positions.
ui.tip.export_semitone: Shift MIDI/ADOFAI export by semitones. Added to Export Oct.
ui.tip.snap_division: Grid subdivisions per beat. 1 = beat, 4 = quarter-beat positions.
ui.tip.display_mode:
wavetone: block-style pitch view
ridge: emphasize pitch peaks
smooth: smooth spectrogram
ui.tip.analysis_profile:
Fast: lower detail and faster
Normal: balanced
Precise: higher pitch detail and slower
Full C0-C10: widest range and slower
ui.tip.cqt_resolution: CQT pitch resolution. Microtonal modes preserve sub-semitone rows and require re-analysis.
ui.tip.curve_shape: Default curve shape for Alt+drag Curve/Glide notes.
ui.tip.curve_interpolation: Interpolation used by Curve/Glide notes in pitch or Hz space.
ui.tip.apply_interp: Apply the selected interpolation to selected Curve/Glide notes.
ui.tip.target_angle: Override the Angle Compression target angle for selected notes/zips.
ui.tip.apply_angle: Apply Target Angle to selected notes.
ui.tip.clear_angle: Clear Target Angle on selected notes and return to automatic calculation.
